plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Robert Hastings, a researcher known for his 2008 book UFOs and Nukes about UFOs seen near nuclear weapons sites, later wrote a book called Confessions. According to Michels, that book is about Hastings' own personal experiences of being abducted, which would mean the investigator himself became part of the story he studied.
